method: Current official patriarchal, administrative, and parish directories were used to establish Qatari bodies. Search engines and maps were used only to discover first-party sources. Overlapping jurisdictional claims are preserved without adjudication, and no body was inferred from population, clergy visits, or an unofficial listing.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: The current official directory names three worship sites under the Patriarchal Representation in Qatar. All three are published.

The current official directory names the Vicariate of the State of Qatar and publishes its representative through the Archdiocese of Baghdad, Kuwait and Dependencies. The vicariate is published without inferring a local worship site.
Current official jurisdictional and diaspora material was checked and did not name a separate Qatari body. This records the bounded audit result, not a claim that a body could never exist.
